implementation_summary: Append checksummed migration six; preserve original five migration constants/checksums and qualified historical evidence
Encrypted immutable collection/activation jobs, bounded schedule/attempt state, database-issued leader/job fencing tokens and heartbeat/recovery APIs
Atomic canonical publication update, immutable activation receipt, subscriber invalidation fan-out and job completion under primary row locks
Independent managed manifest and reviewer approval required on every activation/replay; fence lifetime bounded by signed policy/review validity

Authenticated durable restrictive halt serializes with activation; production readers check shared halt in the primary fence statement

multi_instance_concurrency.proof: Independent restricted-role primary connections, 16-worker leader/claim races, 12 concurrent activation retries, stale canonical read and competing old-fence denial

durable_jobs.proof: Encrypted immutable payloads, idempotent enqueue/rebinding rejection, oversized/quota denial, collection handler execution, crash recovery, finite attempts and cancellation

leader_lease_fencing.proof: Exactly one leader and claimant in each 16-worker race; monotonic takeover tokens, bounded DB-clock heartbeats, expired/stale leader and job denial

transactional_outbox.proof: Forced fan-out insertion failure rolls back publication and activation receipt; final activation creates one receipt/two subscriber rows; per-subscriber order, retry, stale acknowledgement and dead-letter blocking

idempotent_activation.proof: Twelve concurrent retries create one activation/fan-out; changed intent and stale competing publication rejected; independent review/signature/schedule gates preserved

distributed_halt.proof: Authenticated halt persisted before local invalidation; independent runtime denies current fence; replay while halted denied; runtime cannot delete halt

retained_security_and_storage.proof: All affected C07.1/C03.8/C04.8/C05.9/C06.4-C06.7 tests pass; eleven-table RLS opening, tenant isolation, immutable payload/receipt privileges, exact durable-byte/row equality and quota denial
